body:
Wow.
T+00:30 - Normal sensations of trips coming in but the new mild 2-ci buzz with its light enhancing effects.
T+01:00 - Hey, this is great. Its like mushrooms but better.  I'm hearing music on stereo inside of video game music on TV inside what I was pressing on the phone...  Tinfoil looks amazing.  What I'm noticing is that the upper effect of this combination is cleaner than mushrooms alone.  I don't know how this is possible but that's what it feels like. In fact so far its almost as if the Mushrooms or 2-CI wash away each others unpleasant qualities.
T+02:00 - Flying and enjoying it. Its a pretty steady ride I like the smoothness.  What I will say is that it feels great and improves all visual aspects of mushrooms.  Its a sunny day out, spill it!
Video Games & Techno always works
